user_story: As a guest, I want to filter bookings by status so that I can see only pending, confirmed, or cancelled reservations.

positive.title: Filter bookings by pending status
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest
Select 'Pending' from the status filter dropdown
Click on the 'Apply Filter' button
positive.expected_result: Only bookings with a status of 'Pending' are displayed

positive.title: Filter bookings by confirmed status
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest
Select 'Confirmed' from the status filter dropdown
Click on the 'Apply Filter' button
positive.expected_result: Only bookings with a status of 'Confirmed' are displayed

positive.title: Filter bookings by cancelled status
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest
Select 'Cancelled' from the status filter dropdown
Click on the 'Apply Filter' button
positive.expected_result: Only bookings with a status of 'Cancelled' are displayed

negative.title: Attempt to filter bookings with an invalid status
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest
Select an invalid status from the status filter dropdown
Click on the 'Apply Filter' button
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the status is invalid

negative.title: Attempt to filter without selecting any status
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest
Leave the status filter dropdown unselected
Click on the 'Apply Filter' button
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating a status must be selected

edge.title: Filter bookings on a page with no reservations
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest with no existing reservations
Select 'Pending' from the status filter dropdown
Click on the 'Apply Filter' button
edge.expected_result: A message is displayed indicating that there are no bookings available for the selected status

edge.title: Filter bookings with a very large number of reservations
steps: Navigate to the bookings page as a guest that has a large dataset of reservations
Select 'Confirmed' from the status filter dropdown
Click on the 'Apply Filter' button
edge.expected_result: Only confirmed bookings are displayed without performance degradation
